Preserve the printed ferocity asterisk, Light Side Force icon and numerical attributes. Original printed face: [[:File:Dagobah-D-sleen-decipher-archive.gif]].

== Unsupported matching list in card data ==
The pinned Players Committee Sleen record listed the following under matching; that data is retained here for provenance:
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">* [[Boba Fett]]
* [[Boba Fett]] (CC)
* [[Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle]]
* [[Boba Fett, Bounty Hunter]]
</syntaxhighlight>
The [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], PDF page 100, limits matching pairs to pilot/starship, pilot/vehicle and weapon/character pairs, or an explicit game-text instruction. Sleen is a creature and its text supplies no matching-pair instruction. The list was therefore removed from the article while the original source record remains preserved.
